description: Phase 1 Head-to-Head (H2H) module configuration. H2H computes the DIRECT game score difference between pA and pB (the margin) from the pre-built normalised set scores, awarding points per game of score difference. It is decoupled from the Phase 0 absolute-point rating (which tracks no margins). All values here, never in code.

percentage.description: H2H percentage aggregation: total rating points gathered by each player across their direct historical encounters, converted into a relative balance out of 100%. Linear constraint for this iteration. An exponential scaling expansion factor will be added later to prevent high-margin victories from collapsing into close margins (e.g. 51%-49%); it remains DISABLED for this version.
